theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k) (β γ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (γ t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (γ t) = X (β 1) - X (β 0)
